You will find each active MLS® townhome listing in Chilliwack, BC here. The sub-areas are compared in the notes that follow.
Sardis South
Sardis South: recent subdivisions plus townhome sites, stretching toward Cultus Lake Road and the Vedder River.
Garrison Crossing
Garrison Crossing: built where CFB Chilliwack used to be, it is a walkable village that combines heritage-style homes, townhomes and condos.
Promontory
Promontory: newer townhome complexes and hillside view homes sit above Sardis, built mainly in the years 1995–2020.
Vedder Crossing
Vedder Crossing: at the commercial heart of the south side, you get condos and townhomes by the Vedder River.
Chilliwack Proper East
Chilliwack Proper East: neighbourhoods in central Chilliwack made up of older detached homes, duplexes and infill townhomes.
Sardis West Vedder
Sardis West Vedder: the area west of Vedder Road. Quiet cul-de-sacs and gated adult complexes are here, with the Vedder River trails nearby.

A Chilliwack townhome is strata-titled, so the BC Strata Property Act applies. Before you remove subjects, collect Form B, the depreciation report, two years of strata minutes and the bylaws, paying attention to the rules on rentals, pets and age restrictions. In 55+ and 45+ complexes, the age bylaws bind at least one occupant.

Floodplain: portions of Rosedale, Greendale, Yarrow, Fairfield Island and lower Sardis sit within the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, which the City's dike network protects. Get the property's flood construction level, then check lender and insurer requirements, and confirm if title carries a geotechnical or floodplain covenant.

Schools and transit: SD33 (School District 33) is the district for Chilliwack. Elementary catchments include Watson, Unsworth and Vedder, and the secondary options include G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and Sardis Secondary. Verify the catchment with SD33 before you buy. BC Transit routes in Chilliwack use Luckakuck Way, Vedder Road and Young Road, and Route 66 (Fraser Valley Express) runs from Chilliwack to Abbotsford and on to Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Where are townhomes for sale in Chilliwack usually located?

Most townhomes in Chilliwack come up in Sardis South, Garrison Crossing, Promontory, Vedder Crossing, Chilliwack Proper East and Sardis West Vedder. Each area has its own mix of age, lot size and price, so I recommend shortlisting two or three neighbourhoods before you book showings.
How often do these Chilliwack townhome listings update?
Listings on this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed several times a day, so new listings, price changes and sold statuses appear quickly.
What zoning, strata or ALR items should I review before purchasing a townhome in Chilliwack?

Strata title applies to townhomes under the BC Strata Property Act. Before subjects are removed, the depreciation report, the last two years of strata minutes, Form B and the bylaws on age restrictions, rentals and pets should all be in your hands. Age rules in 55+ and 45+ complexes are enforced on at least one occupant.
Are any Chilliwack townhomes in the floodplain?

Anyone looking at lower Sardis, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow or Fairfield Island should know parts of them fall in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, covered by the City's dike network. Ask about the property's flood construction level, what lenders and insurers will require, and if title shows any geotechnical or floodplain covenant that is registered.
Which schools serve Chilliwack townhomes?

In Chilliwack, schools fall under School District 33 (SD33). North-side homes feed Chilliwack Secondary, while homes in Sardis and on the south side feed Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham. Catchment boundaries change over time, so verify with SD33 for a specific address.
Is public transit available near Chilliwack townhomes?

Yes. Chilliwack has local BC Transit routes on Young Road, Vedder Road and Luckakuck Way, along with the Fraser Valley Express to Abbotsford and Langley. Ryder Lake, Greendale and Columbia Valley, being rural, get little or no bus service.
